title: What the game states
plain: Facts the game itself states about how chunks are built, each re-derived in code from a quoted source and checked against what the lab measured.
why: A fact that the lab can reproduce is a fact we can build on.
done_when: Each fact has a quoted source, a small program that gives the same number, and a lab measurement it agrees with.

title: The counting maths
plain: The counting maths behind which orders make the same world, each theorem re-derived in code on small cases from its paper.
why: The order law rests on known theorems, and re-deriving them checks we read them right.
done_when: Each theorem reproduces its paper's worked numbers on small cases.

title: Reading the terrain
plain: The tools that read the shape of the real terrain, each re-derived in code from its paper on a worked example.
why: The terrain results are only as good as the tools that produced them.
done_when: Each tool reproduces the paper's worked example exactly.

title: Used by round 3
plain: Where a study material is used by a round 3 finding: the implementation must reproduce a number that round 3 already recorded.
why: This is the test that the study actually matters to the findings.
done_when: Each named use reproduces a recorded round 3 number.
